inner: Pinned author coefficient formula, initial .3, Adam lr .01 betas .9/.999 eps1e-8, 100 updates. Public second teacher has zero task vector and hence zero coefficient gradient.
precision: FP64 shadow of last-block recovery; original FP32 historical results unchanged. Identical duplicated input groups reduced algebraically to 64 student forwards, with the original sum of both teacher losses.
reuse: First eleven blocks fixed at existing synthetic ProDistill result. Their teachers and weights are unchanged along this direction.
question: Does one B update that preserves the old native/TA/AGA synthetic CLS outputs reduce correct predictions after coefficient recovery?
access: Frozen target/base/head, original 160 generated images and fixed16384 synthetic layer inputs. No real images or other task expert.
parameterization: Keep old publication A,a,b and every other parameter fixed. Only B changes. Three800-view activation grids native, target+public TA.5, original AGA+public TA.5 yield H with2400 rows and3072 columns. ThinQR of H.T; dB=gradient-(gradient Q)Q.T. No rank tuning. Reduce this exact finite source-output-preserving space conservatively if numerical rank is deficient.
objective: Maximize mean(max incorrect logit - clean expert predicted-class logit) after100 coefficient steps on the original64 synthetic training images. Differentiate both coefficient updates and teacher targets.
finite_step: One direction, unitFrobenius dB. Choose the smaller positive root of the original native-energy quadratic<=tau and B relative norm<=4, times(1-1e-6). No line search or retries. A range<=2 inherited from old point. Round final B toFP32 and check actual original energy again.
evaluation: Source output differences and sameargmax for native/TA/AGA all800views. Recovery top1 counts on64fit and remaining96 original unrolled synthetic images;96 previously exposed elsewhere, not globally fresh. Require fewer correct in BOTH groups and unchanged old class outputs in all three contexts before any natural evaluation.
limits: A finite feasibility check of one restricted direction. Exact source preservation is not a guarantee for natural images/unknown partners, nor a necessary condition on all defenses. Jointweight matching/public replacements not solved. Standard constrained differentiation tools; not a novel method claim.
stopping: Save and stop on failure. No tuning threshold, amplitude, layer, rank, seed or data. Old failed entropy model remains closed.

references.Trap2: https://arxiv.org/html/2601.21898v2 Table14 and training_scripts/8vision_training_full_trap2.py:139-187; native and actual task-vector-scaled CE objectives motivate retaining fusion effects. This probe is not a replication.
